theory.title: Likely to, unlikely to, bound to y certain to
theory.explanation: Usa be likely/unlikely to + infinitivo para expresar probabilidad. Be bound to y be certain to expresan una expectativa muy firme. Estas expresiones sirven para hacer predicciones prudentes y precisas.
theory.tip: Likely to = probable; unlikely to = poco probable; bound/certain to = casi seguro.

content.passage: Media experts expect several changes over the next few years. Online news is likely to become more personalised, while printed newspapers are unlikely to disappear completely. Podcasts are bound to attract new audiences, and streaming services are certain to continue growing. However, reliable journalism is likely to remain important. Experts also believe that people are unlikely to trust every headline they see online.

items.prompt: Predict how online news is likely to change.
items.modelAnswer: Online news is likely to become more personalised, with readers choosing topics and receiving updates on their phones. However, I hope trusted news organisations will continue to offer detailed reports and explain how they check information.

items.prompt: What kind of programme is unlikely to become popular?
items.modelAnswer: A programme that repeats the same jokes and has no clear subject is unlikely to become popular for long. Viewers have many choices, so I think they prefer original ideas and interesting presenters.

items.prompt: Describe a series that is bound to attract attention.
items.modelAnswer: A new travel series about small towns is bound to attract attention because people enjoy discovering places that are not famous tourist destinations. If the presenters meet local residents, the programme could be especially engaging.

items.prompt: Talk about a debate that is certain to continue.
items.modelAnswer: The debate about how much time children should spend online is certain to continue. Technology is changing quickly, and families and schools need to decide how to use it safely and sensibly.

items.prompt: Explain why podcasts are likely to grow.
items.modelAnswer: Podcasts are likely to grow because people can listen while travelling, exercising or doing housework. They are also relatively easy to produce, so there are programmes about almost every interest.

items.prompt: What media habit is unlikely to disappear?
items.modelAnswer: Watching short videos is unlikely to disappear because they are quick and easy to share. However, I think people will continue to enjoy longer films and documentaries when they want more detail.

items.prompt: Predict how technology is bound to affect journalism.
items.modelAnswer: Technology is bound to affect journalism by helping reporters analyse large amounts of information and publish updates quickly. At the same time, journalists will need to check automated content and protect reliable sources.

items.prompt: Describe something you are certain to do this year.
items.modelAnswer: I'm certain I will attend at least one live music event this year. I have already checked the dates of a festival near my home, and I hope to buy tickets when they become available.

items.prompt: Talk about a trend that is likely to continue.
items.modelAnswer: The trend towards watching programmes online is likely to continue. People enjoy choosing when and where to watch, although live events and shared cinema experiences will probably remain popular.

items.prompt: Make predictions about the future of entertainment.
items.modelAnswer: Entertainment will probably become more interactive, with viewers choosing different story paths or joining live discussions. I think traditional books, films and concerts will still be important because people enjoy shared cultural experiences.
